definitions.explanation: When all items of a product have been purchased and none remain for sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{売|う}り{切|き}れです。
⟦{人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}→人気商品：21609_ninkishouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The popular product sold out quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定|げんてい}{品|ひん}→限定品：16189_genteihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}→発売開始：22166_hatsubaikaishi⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧で{売|う}り{切|き}れになった。
examples.english: The limited edition item sold out 30 minutes after going on sale.

notes:
{売|う}り{切|き}れ is the noun form meaning "sold out" — the state of having no remaining stock. Derived from the verb {売|う}り{切|き}れる (to sell out).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ (noun): the sold-out state
- {売|う}り{切|き}れる (verb): to sell out (intransitive)
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become sold out
- {売|う}り{切|き}れだ / {売|う}り{切|き}れです: is sold out

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ⟦{御免|ごめん}→御免：00072_gomen⟧: while supplies last (common on shop signs)
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ⟦{続出|ぞくしゅつ}→続出：13860_zokushutsu⟧: selling out one after another

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧: out of stock (emphasis on unavailability)
- ⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧: completely sold out (more formal, used in announcements)
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧なし: no stock remaining
